Performance Pillars

The Render Trap

Render distance impact is exponential. Increasing from 10 to 20 chunks quadruples the workload.

Rule of Thumb: Keep it under 10 if you have FPS issues.

extension

Mod Loaders

Fabric + Sodium is currently the king of performance, often doubling FPS over OptiFine.

Use Forge/Embeddium only if you need specific mods that require Forge.

memory

RAM Allocation

More is NOT always better. Allocating too much RAM (e.g., 10GB for vanilla) causes massive "Lag Spikes" when the Garbage Collector runs.

Target: 4GB for Vanilla, 6-8GB for Modded.
